author: kavanaghgareth
title: Paid Artist Open Call for Paradise Towers 2 Backup Strips
content: Paid artist open call out! Yes, we're looking for new artists for the backup strips on Paradise Towers 2, out this February. Build high for happiness! Submit sequential art samples to info@cutawaycomics.co.uk by November 29, 2026. Open to different styles for the Scary Cat backup strip.

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists and Lineartists for When the Silent Bird Sings
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE. Looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. Positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, and more. Paid positions (open to collaboration/internships). Send professional email to whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with name, location, position, resume/portfolio, rates per panel, turnaround, software, payment method. No deadline, rolling acceptance. Absolutely no AI use.

author: young.onion
title: Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery Collection
content: WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! Looking for talented artists for upcoming stationery collection featuring chubby characters, pastel doodles, stickers, washi tapes, etc. How to apply: Follow @young.onion, comment with emoji and tag friend, DM with portfolio link or fill form in bio. Email: info@youngonion.in.

author: szewomenofhope
title: Looking for an Illustrator for Education Projects
content: We're looking for an Illustrator! Sze Women of Hope is looking for a creative illustrator to collaborate on upcoming education and community projects supporting refugee communities. Location: Remote. Work: Project-based | Flexible. Send your portfolio to szewomen@gmail.com.
